caption: The drawing depicts a carved statue of a woman standing on a rectangular pedestal. The woman has long brown hair and wears a colorful dress with a green bodice, orange sleeves, blue-green skirt, and yellow trim details. She has a yellow necklace, yellow round earrings, and holds an object that appears to be a bundle of cigars in her right hand and a small block or sign in her left hand. She wears a headdress featuring three large feathers in brown, red, and yellow colors. Her shoes are blue with yellow trim, and one leg is crossed over the other. The pedestal has inscriptions: “S.A. Robb Carver 114 Center Street” and “GEORGE W. JOYCE TOBACCONIST DEPOT FOR” written on its front face. The overall composition is centered, and the background is plain and uncolored. The drawing employs soft, blended colors and delicate detailing throughout the statue and pedestal. There are initials “M.A.R.S.” in red to the right of the statue.
title: Cigar Store Indian
